summary: Implemented the ggml-ABI-matched Q4_K_M coopmat-KHR kernel variant (six ABI deltas, VERBATIM from the M3.6 leader otherwise), the one required codegen feature (coopmat_store_col, column-major layout operand), the static ABI-conformance golden suite (anti-circularity anchor), the GPU correctness/equiv test suites, the resident A/B bench, and the upstream/ integration package (spv + byte-array fragment + hand-written patch + REPRODUCE.md). All GPU-dependent claims were MEASURED on real NVIDIA hardware (RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell) available in this environment, not simulated.

codegen_feature_coopmat_store_col.description: 5th cooperative-matrix builtin. Mirrors coopmat_store exactly (arity 4, void, statement-only); the ONLY delta is the emitted SPIR-V layout operand (ColumnMajorKHR=1 instead of RowMajorKHR=0) -- a core SPV_KHR_cooperative_matrix operand, NOT a new capability/extension.

lowering.lexer: RESERVED_COOPMAT_BUILTIN_NAMES gains "coopmat_store_col" (both axc-lexer and axc-hir mirrored copies, sorted)
lowering.hir: CoopMatBuiltin::StoreCol variant + CoopMatStoreLayout{RowMajor,ColMajor} discriminant added to HirStmt::CoopMatStore (orthogonal to typing); typecheck rejects StoreCol targeting a shared array (no shared-memory column-major store)
lowering.parser: no change required -- coopmat_store_col dispatches through the existing generic BuiltinCallStmt path via the reserved-name list
lowering.codegen: emit_coopmat_store_col_inline (crates/axc-codegen/src/coopmat.rs) is a byte-copy of emit_coopmat_store_inline with COL_MAJOR_LAYOUT=1; body.rs dispatches Buffer-path stores on the layout discriminant; Shared-path ColMajor is a defensive fail-closed codegen error (unreachable given the typecheck guard)

codegen_feature_coopmat_store_col.measured_deviation_from_spec: AT-2987's spec text claimed the ggml variant's capability set is IDENTICAL to the leader's. MEASURED result: the ggml variant correctly DROPS StorageBuffer16BitAccess (cap 4433) vs the leader -- a direct, expected consequence of retyping the B SSBO from f16 to f32 (Sec.2.5). The AT-2987 test was written to assert this specific, documented drop (and reject any OTHER capability delta) rather than blind equality.

six_abi_deltas_gpu_proven: n_blocks_per_row derived as stride_a/256u32 (ggml stride_a is ELEMENTS)
17-field ggml push struct consumed, reading only the leading six (M,N,K,stride_a,stride_b,stride_d @ offsets 0,4,8,12,16,20)
B retyped readonly_buffer[f32], read transposed (ggml [N,K] row-major), staged f32->f16 via the existing M3.5 f32_to_f16 builtin
D stored column-major with stride_d via the new coopmat_store_col builtin
grid axis order swapped to ggml's convention (gid(0)->M-row, gid(1)->N-col); host wg_denoms={32,32,1}

The patch's guard condition #8 (split_k==1 check) calls ggml_vk_guess_split_k inline since the split_k local is not yet declared at the :8239 interception point -- architecturally sound (the function signature was confirmed against the pinned source) but NOT compile-checked against the real headers (the patch is explicitly not built/applied in this milestone). Disclosed in REPRODUCE.md as a KNOWN LIMITATION.
The patch's CMake wiring for -DGGML_VULKAN_AXIOM_Q4K is not included (a small, mechanical addition left for the actual build pass) -- disclosed in REPRODUCE.md.
LOC significantly exceeds the cap (see loc_breakdown) -- disclosed per the spec's explicit 'honest overage disclosure' instruction, not hidden or papered over.

The resident bench diverges from the M3.x sibling pattern in ONE respect: the per-shape correctness pre-flight (CPU oracle + abs_scale) is MEMOIZED in a process-global map so it runs exactly once per (kernel, shape) instead of inside every criterion sample. Without this, the A/B-shape sweep (two multi-minute oracle computations per criterion invocation) took hours. The oracle is still genuinely computed and still gates the printed VALID/INVALID label; the memo cannot mask a regression because the fixture seeds are byte-identical across invocations. Disclosed as a deliberate, bounded pattern deviation.

AT-2997's 'byte-reproducible from the pinned source + assignments' claim is anchored by AT-2985/2987 (which both compile via the exact same compile_source_with_assignments path used to generate the committed .spv) rather than a dedicated byte-for-byte diff test against the committed file on disk -- the regeneration command was manually verified to reproduce the same compile path in this coder pass.
deviations: AT-2987's capability-set assertion was written to require the ggml variant's caps to be a subset of the leader's PLUS exactly the documented StorageBuffer16BitAccess drop, rather than literal set equality as the spec's Sec.4 capabilities paragraph states -- this is a MEASURED correction (the B-retype to f32 genuinely and correctly drops that capability requirement), not an implementation bug. Recorded as a measured_deviation_from_spec above.

The host patch's three hunks span TWO logical sites per the spec's Sec.7.2 framing (creation + override) but THREE physical hunks in the diff (a small vk_device_struct member declaration is a necessary companion to the creation hunk, since the standalone pipeline needs a struct slot). Disclosed in the patch's own header comment and REPRODUCE.md.

No separate byte-array-fragment or .spv regeneration CI test file was created as a distinct AT-2997 test; the coverage is folded into the existing AT-2985/2987 compile-anchor pattern in compile_shared_examples.rs, which exercises the identical compile path.
